title: UpgradePromptView
description: Source of truth: derived projection of SessionHumanView × Manifest{kind:'onboarding'} for a specific agent (Operational, Category C). Reads the onboarding Manifest payload to discover which prompts exist and their trigger conditions, then joins with the agent's SessionHumanView to determine which prompts are currently active. Reconstructable from EconomicEvent stream + onboarding Manifest at any time.

agentId.description: AgentPubKey of the human whose upgrade prompts this projects

activePrompts.description: Ordered list of currently-active (non-dismissed) upgrade prompts derived from the onboarding Manifest

promptId.description: Stable identifier for this prompt as declared in the onboarding Manifest

trigger.description: The lamadEventType or session condition that activated this prompt (e.g. 'path-started', 'return-visit', 'progress-at-risk')

title.description: Short display title for the prompt

message.description: Human-readable message explaining why the prompt appeared

benefits.description: Bullet-point benefits the agent gains by upgrading (from the Manifest payload)

computedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this projection was last computed
